title: A complaint reopens an unanswered question

description.Situation: Alice asks a question in the room, and Codex says nothing. Later, Alice makes an oblique complaint about the silence.
description.Tension: Alice complaining isn't asking a question again.
description.Behaviour to evaluate: Does TP read the hidden intent in Alice's complaint, which hides a request for a reponse?

purpose.Expected outcome: Codex reads Alice's complaint in relation to the unanswered question as an indirect invitation to respond.

static.Background: Alice and Codex are chatting about a sign Alice has quoted from her workplace.
static.Start: Start from the conversation below with no earlier library state.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Someone's put a sign above the broken printer: 'Please be patient. It is trying its best.'

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: An unusually supportive workplace for a printer.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: It's been jammed since Monday. There's now a little drawing of a bed beside it.

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: So it has sick leave as well.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: My manager's just replied to the sign in the staff chat.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Want to hear what they said?
